<!-- Generated by `chainmail docs`. Do not edit: change the command's help and run `go tool stave docs:commands`. -->

Send a complete RFC 5322 message as given, from --file or, with -, from stdin.
Its From must be the account's address and it must have a Message-ID.
The recipients are its To, Cc and Bcc; the Bcc header is removed before
sending. Without --idempotency-key, the key is derived from the account
and the bytes, so sending the same file again within 7 days does not send
twice. To send it again on purpose, pass a new --idempotency-key.

## Usage

```text
chainmail send-raw (--file F | -) [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
chainmail send-raw --account work --file message.eml
cat message.eml | chainmail send-raw --account work -
```

## Flags

```text
      --account string           the account to send from; the message's From must be its address (required)
      --file string              the message to send
      --idempotency-key string   the key that stops a repeat from sending again (default: derived from the bytes)
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
